what: A small ink dot at the end of the underline (lower right) spreads in five steps (steps 5) over .3s on hover into a dark ink blot that is densest in the center, and on release shrinks back to a dot in the same steps in reverse. It is five blot layers stacked one more at a time under a mask, so the center gets darker as it spreads. The color follows the text color, so on a dark backdrop it becomes a white blot. Applied to the whole card, with the dot placed on a child (pod) inside the title, it spreads wherever the card is hovered.

options.--fx-size: Dot and blot cell size, default 1em (card titles .6em · .8em)
options.--fx-bottom: Position below the dot cell, default .8em (above the underline). The vertical button overrides it with left .7em · bottom 0
options.--fx-top: Spot above the dot cell, default auto — to put it at the end of a large heading line, give 1em·.5em with --fx-bottom: auto
options.[data-fx-part=pod]: Child to hold the dot — if none, put it on the element’s own ::after (both the child and the element use ::after for this part)
